dz: 由加斯帕尔·德·波多拉(Gaspar de Portolá)所率领的探险队离开其在圣地亚哥的基地并出发去寻找蒙特里港(现加利福尼亚州蒙特里).
de: An expedition led by Gaspar de Portolá leaves its base in San Diego and sets out to find the Port of Monterey (now Monterey, California).

t: 父亲朱尼佩罗·塞拉(Junipero Serra)发现了加利福尼亚州的第一个任务"圣迭戈-德阿…
te: Father Junípero Serra founds California's first mission, Mission San Diego de Alcalá. Over the following decades, it ev…
dz: 父亲朱尼佩罗·塞拉(Junipero Serra)发现了加利福尼亚州的第一个任务"圣迭戈-德阿尔卡拉使命". 在接下来的几十年里,它演化为加利福尼亚州圣迭戈市.
de: Father Junípero Serra founds California's first mission, Mission San Diego de Alcalá. Over the following decades, it evolves into the city of San Diego, California.

te: Dartmouth College is founded by the Reverend Eleazar Wheelock, with a royal charter from King George III, on land donat…
dz: 达特茅斯学院由 Eleazar Wheelock 牧师建立，并获得乔治三世国王的皇家特许状，土地由皇家总督 John Wentworth 捐赠。
de: Dartmouth College is founded by the Reverend Eleazar Wheelock, with a royal charter from King George III, on land donated by Royal governor John Wentworth.

t: 战争以清朝永远从缅甸撤军而结束.
te: The war ends with the Qing dynasty withdrawing from Burma forever.
dz: 中伯战争:战争以清朝永远从缅甸撤军而结束.
de: Sino-Burmese War: The war ends with the Qing dynasty withdrawing from Burma forever.
